name: stratos-trucking-profit-navigator
description: Stratos Trucking Profit Navigator — subscription financial dashboard for trucking owner-operators

scripts.build: npm run build -w @stratos/financial-engine && npm run build -w @stratos/api && npm run build -w @stratos/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @stratos/financial-engine && npm run typecheck -w @stratos/api && npm run typecheck -w @stratos/web
scripts.build:api: npm run build -w @stratos/financial-engine && npm run prisma:generate -w @stratos/api && npm run build -w @stratos/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @stratos/financial-engine && npm run build -w @stratos/web
